---
title: "charts"
format: html
---

```{r}

# Define vectors (aligned in time)
days <- -12:13

# Observed trend (solid)
observed <- c(rep(NA, 12),
              0.213, 0.212, 0.211, 0.209, 0.206, 0.203,
              0.200, 0.197, 0.194, 0.191, 0.188, 0.185,
              0.181, 0.177)

# Counterfactual trend (dashed)
counterfactual <- c(rep(NA, 12),
                    0.175, 0.178, 0.181, 0.179, 0.176, 0.175,
                    0.176, 0.178, 0.181, 0.184, 0.187, 0.189,
                    0.187, 0.185)

# Create base plot
plot(days, observed,
     type = "l",
     lwd = 3,
     col = "gray30",
     ylim = c(0.15, 0.23),
     xlab = "Days relative to Shooting",
     ylab = "Proportion of Stops That Involve Force",
     xaxt = "n")

# Add counterfactual trend
lines(days, counterfactual,
      lwd = 3,
      lty = 2,
      col = "gray50")

# Add vertical event line at day 0
abline(v = 0, lwd = 2)

# Customize x-axis ticks
axis(1, at = seq(-12, 12, 4))

# Add legend
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Counterfactual Trend", "Observed Trend"),
       lty = c(2, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       col = c("gray40", "gray10"),
       bty = "n")

# Optional annotations
text(6, 0.205, "Observed trend\nafter event", pos = 4)
text(3, 0.165, "Counterfactual trend\nafter event", pos = 4)

```
